title: Stripe API pricing: plans, free tier and what to watch for
snippet:
Stripe is billed per transaction (2.9% + $0.30). It has a free tier: Unlimited test-mode sandbox (no CC); pay-per-transaction live. The paid plans we list start at 2.9% + 30¢ (Standard (pay-as-you-go, US online)).
## Plans and prices
| Plan | Price | What it covers |
|---|---|---|
| Standard (pay-as-you-go, US online) | 2.9% + 30¢ | Per successful online card charge; no setup or monthly fees. |
| In-person (Terminal, US) | 2.7% + 5¢ | Per successful in-person card payment. |
| Manually-keyed cards (US) | 3.4% + 30¢ | Per successful keyed-in card transaction. |
| ACH direct debit (US) | 0.8% (capped at $5) | Per ACH payment; disputes billed at $15 each. |
| Billing (subscriptions) | 0.7% of billing volume | Pay-as-you-go add-on; Tax add-on is 0.5% per transaction. |
| Custom / Enterprise | Contact sales | Interchange-plus (IC+) pricing, volume discounts, and multi-product discounts for large businesses. |
## How Stripe bills you
The pricing model is **per transaction (2.9% + $0.30)**. The reference-standard payments API: best-in-class docs, SDKs in every major language, official MCP server, and instant self-serve sandbox. Best suited to: developer-first payments platform.
